verdict.rationale: Syncing saved hosts and connection settings across devices is a fair question for a Git client that stores hosting-provider and SSH configurations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never shows these settings syncing between devices. Auto-Sync and Background Sync only commit, pull and push repository content to remotes, which is a different capability. Hosting-provider configuration and the one-time data transfer during the app migration are adjacent features and earn no credit.
